name: Simple Role Based Pricing
author: tlloancy

sections.description:
Simple Role Based Pricing allows you to set custom prices or discounts for WooCommerce products based on user roles. Easily configure prices per product or globally, apply bulk actions, and display role-specific prices to users.

Features

  • Set fixed prices or discounts (percentage or fixed amount) per user role.
  • Configure global pricing rules for all products.
  • Bulk edit prices for multiple products.
  • Quick edit support for individual products.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce simple and variable products.

Compatibility

  • WooCommerce: Required (version 4.0 or higher recommended).
  • User Role Editor: Optional, for managing custom user roles.
  • Other role management plugins: Works with plugins that add custom roles to WordPress.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the simple-role-based-pricing folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under WooCommerce > Settings > Role Based Pricing.
sections.faq:
Does it work with variable products?

Yes, it supports both simple and variable products.

Can I use it with custom roles?

Yes, it works with any role registered in WordPress, including custom roles created by plugins like User Role Editor.
